about.intro_content: Prof. Chao-Nan Qian is a Professor in the Department of Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center (SYSUCC) and President of Guangzhou Concord Cancer Center. His research focuses on the molecular mechanisms of NPC metastasis, carcinogenesis and tumour angiogenesis.
about.detailed_content: Prof. Qian trained in medicine and oncology at Sun Yat-sen University of Medical Sciences before completing postdoctoral research at the University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center and the Van Andel Research Institute in Michigan. He served as Deputy Director of the Laboratory of Translational Cancer Research at the National Cancer Center Singapore before rejoining SYSUCC in 2007, later serving as Vice President of SYSUCC from 2013 before becoming President of Guangzhou Concord Cancer Center in 2019. He has published over 180 peer-reviewed articles and has been supported by a State Key Grant and four general grants from the National Natural Science Foundation of China.

items.question: Does Prof. Chao-Nan Qian accept international patients?
items.answer: CancerFax can coordinate medical report review and consultation support for international patients seeking an opinion related to nasopharyngeal carcinoma at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center, subject to hospital availability and case acceptance.

items.question: What is Prof. Qian's area of specialisation?
items.answer: Prof. Qian specialises in nasopharyngeal carcinoma, with particular research and clinical expertise in tumour metastasis, carcinogenesis and tumour angiogenesis.

items.question: How can I request a consultation or second opinion?
items.answer: Submit your medical reports through CancerFax. The CancerFax team reviews the documents, prepares the case for submission, and coordinates next steps with SYSUCC's International Medical Center, subject to availability.

items.question: Is Prof. Qian involved in research on NPC metastasis?
items.answer: Yes. Prof. Qian has authored over 180 peer-reviewed papers on the molecular mechanisms of NPC metastasis and related cancer biology, supported by multiple national research grants.

items.question: Does Prof. Qian practise at more than one institution?
items.answer: Prof. Qian holds a professorship in the Department of Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma at SYSUCC and also serves as President of Guangzhou Concord Cancer Center; specific appointment logistics should be confirmed with CancerFax at the time of booking.
